Upstream source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
Version: n7.1.1, commit db69d06eeeab4f46da15030a80d539efb4503ca8
No GPL, nonfree, or LGPLv3-only options are enabled.
The unmodified libraries are dynamically linked. Their exact build options are
in cmake/FalloutMovies.cmake in the FalloutQuest source repository:
https://github.com/dwalton29/FalloutQuest
To rebuild/relink, obtain that repository and the pinned upstream source, then
build the Android project. Replacement libavformat, libavcodec, libavutil and
libswscale libraries can be packaged by the same CMake/Gradle build. The included
development signing key supports installing the rebuilt APK. No proprietary
Fallout files are provided by this project.
